summary: R253 binds R252 programmable indexed dispatch readiness to the actual current MANAGED index-buffer CPU-shadow values. It converts the live IA byte offset plus StartIndex into an exact shadow element start, scans the exact 16/32-bit index window, and fails closed when any source index falls outside the declared D3D9 MinVertexIndex..MaxVertexIndex range. No DrawIndexed or NativeDrawPath activation is added.

The smallest successor is a programmable R253 receipt that binds those actual values to the R252 snapshot without activating DrawIndexed.
